aboutMe.title: Ahmed Hanye Hossny
aboutMe.bio1: Hey there! I'm Ahmed, a Software Engineer and Computer Science graduate specializing in building high-performance, local-first web applications. I bridge the gap between pixel-perfect frontends and robust backends, working deeply with React 19, Next.js, and Django Ninja.
aboutMe.bio2: With hands-on industry experience as a front-end dev and a couple of live SaaS side-projects under my belt, I'm currently looking for Full-Time Frontend or Full-Stack Engineering roles where I can help scale cutting-edge web apps.

skills.title: Technical Skills & Expertise:
skills.interestOffline: Offline-First & Local-First Architectures: Local SQLite storage + background database synchronization (PowerSync).
skills.interestFsd: Feature-Sliced Design (FSD): Modular, clean, and scalable architecture pattern.
skills.interestHeadless: Headless & Microservices: Decoupled Next.js static exports paired with Django backend REST/Ninja APIs.
skills.interestTooling: Modern Web Tooling & DX: Fast dev pipelines using Bun, uv, Ruff, and Steiger.
skills.interestTesting: E2E & Automated Interaction Testing: Storybook play functions, Playwright, and Vitest.

interviewFlow.title: InterviewFlow (Graduation Project)
interviewFlow.desc: A platform for helping both interviewees and interviewers. Allows creation of structured interview pipelines with assessments, coding challenges, and real-time analytics to find the best talent faster. Completed full project implementation.
